name: The Lifeboat House
reading: Misty's town keeps the lake's rescue service (docs/world-building/TOWN_CHARACTER.md gym2_town: rescue boats, a record of every arrival; prismarine and mud brick, dark oak, spruce). The cistern the town draws from and the ledger gallery above the race are already carved under the template hall (data/gym_interiors.json gym2). Beyond the ledger gallery, past the lifeguard, is where the service keeps its boat: a long timber-framed boat house in mud brick with a prismarine quay, a launch channel along its whole south side with the boat still lying in it, buoys on the water and a lifeline strung on posts along the quay edge, a lifebuoy painted on the end wall. A player comes through a door the lifeguard guards, down a slipway stair, into the hall's west end and walks its whole length toward the lookout deck at the east end: a raised timber deck on a dark prismarine plinth, three courses above the quay, where the watch is kept and Misty stands.

leader.seat_why: on the lookout deck's top (y95 = floor y92 + 3), on the hall's axis z2887, three in from the deck's front trim (x1624) and three from the end wall. THE ONE SOURCE of Misty's seat once this record exists (tools/gym_arenas.py leader_seats): data/gym_interiors.json gym2 leader.expect_spawner_at (1605, 132, 2874) is where the template puts it and where the move starts.

entry.why: THE JUNCTION. Misty's route is the well, not the hall: hall, 38 down the scaffolding to the cistern, the one-way fall into the race, the three mouths, the true one up into the ledger gallery where the lifeguard stands, the sill down to the cistern, the well back up (data/gym_interiors.json gym2 route). The template spawner, one over which the walk would start, is (1605, 133, 2874) in the hall. The arena hangs off that route at its LAST gated room: a door in the ledger gallery's south wall at (1606, 99..100, 2877), east of the lifeguard (1604, 99, 2874) and of the true mouth (1602..1603), so the mouth's exit puts a player beside the lifeguard and the door lies beyond him. The descent from the hall is therefore the well that already exists (gallery floor y98 to hall floor y133 = 35 courses), not a stair this arena builds; the arena's own descent is the 6-tread slipway. route_end is the first cell INSIDE the arena, the slipway's top landing, because tools/gym_arenas.py has no model of the template or the dig: it sees the door as a solid block (in the world it is `open=true`, a leaf swung back to the jamb, passable to a player), and its walk has to start this side of it. Mutation: the same record with the door cells as air fails the shell rule ('2 open cells touch unwritten ground, first [1606, 99, 2877] beside [1606, 99, 2876]', the gallery's own air), so the door is what closes the arena to the check and opens it to the world. What the check therefore does NOT prove: that a player in the gallery reaches this landing. entry.floor is where the slipway lets the player out of the hall's north-west arch: 29.4 from the lookout stand, farther than rctmod's forceBattleMaxDistance + 1 = 17.

battle.why: Cobblemon Battle Positions (docs/world-building/GYM_ARENAS.md): both Pokemon blocks one under the floor's top course (y91 under y92), so spawnHeightOffset 2.0 stands each Pokemon on the quay. Misty's team is small: the largest clear radius over all her members is 1.85 (pelipper, model sweep) and the tallest clear height 1.53 (floatzel). Her block (centre x1620.5) is 3.5 from the deck's front trim (x1624) and her disc reaches x1622.35, so it is empty by 1.65; the challenger's (centre x1612.5) is 8 from hers (hitbox 0.96 wide) and 11.5 from the deck face, inside the 16 Battle Positions searches from every cell a battle can start from (the check: 73 of 73). The axis z2887 is one north of the hall's centre line (z2888): the disc reaches z2889.35, the quay-edge rail row begins at z2890, the lockers' row (z2883) ends at z2884, so nothing stands within the disc. The challenger's stand is 3 behind their Pokemon, as the donor gyms set it.

challenge_spawner.why: the Challenge spawner the trainers cycle sets in the template hall (data/challenge_mode.json bosses.kanto_misty.spawner.at, measured there by unit M1) goes back to the rim stair and smooth stone it replaced; the cycle's new cell is two south of the seat on the same deck, (1627, 95, 2885), with the two cells over it left air.

old_seat_restore.why: the template's pool rim at x1605 is a column of smooth quartz stairs facing west over smooth stone (read from the template as placed: cells (1605, 132, 2871..2877) and (1605, 131, ...)); the spawner replaced one of them at z2874 and a straight west stair puts the rim back. data/challenge_mode.json single_leader.restore carries the inner_right stair of the cell north of it, which is the right floor for the Challenge cell and not for this one.

blocks_why: the town's own palette (TOWN_CHARACTER.md gym2_town: prismarine, mud brick, dark oak, spruce) and the interior's own (data/gym_interiors.json gym2 blocks: sea lantern, dark prismarine, barrels, lanterns, chain), plus red and white concrete for the buoys and the lifebuoy. Water is a spawn-condition block, so it is kept inside the gym_misty box, which takes every column out of every compiled spawn file; there is no grass, leaves, sand or carpet.
